writeguard._comment: PROPOSED, NOT INSTALLED. Workspace-level <workspace>/.agents/hooks.json, under its own key so it never replaces Mycelium's plugin hooks. agy is FAIL-CLOSED (verified 2026-11-24, agy 1.5.x -p: a hook whose interpreter is missing exits 127 and the matched tool call is blocked), so the matchers name only the tools the guard handles: a broken install then blocks file reads/writes and run_command, not every tool. The guard prints NOTHING on an allowed PreToolUse (agy reads {} as a deny and {"decision":"allow"} as an auto-approval), so agy's own permission prompts are unchanged. Hook timeouts were not probed. Replace <ABS_PYTHON> and <ABS_PATH_TO> with absolute paths that exist.
